description: Set the whole-lot roof style (uint index into Content.WorldRoofs) and pitch (float, clamped server-side to [0, 1.25]). Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side; server-side Owner via VMTSOAvatarPermissions.Owner — stricter than BuildBuyRoommate). Effect: architecture.RoofStyle and architecture.RoofPitch update for the whole lot. Observable via query-architecture.roof. Cost: free. Wire: VMNetSetRoofCmd { Style, Pitch } on the lot Aries socket. If style >= WorldRoofs.Count the command is silently rejected by the server (Execute returns false).
